info.title: OpenAsy CRM
info.description: Companies, contacts and deals through the pipelines crm.yaml sets, with activities, tasks, quotes as PDF and meeting links. Viewers read everything; editors change what they own; admins change everything.

get.summary: The caller's tasks due and stale deals
Audience, Messages and mail, and whether they answer
Pipeline, forecast, won and lost, reasons, time in stage, by owner
get.description:
The forecast counts a won deal at its value in the month it was won, and an open deal at its value times its stage's probability in the month it is expected to close (this month when that date has passed).

Needs the viewer role.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.description: A pipeline id; the file's first by default.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: me, or a member's id; everyone's by default.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a name, email, city or sector.

post.summary: Add a company

201.description: Added; the caller owns it unless owner says otherwise.

post.description: Needs the editor role.

get.summary: A company with its contacts, deals and activities

patch.description:
Editors change only what they own, or what nobody owns.

Needs the editor role.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a name, email, city or sector.

post.summary: Add a contact
post.description:
An email belongs to one contact only. A new contact is sent to Audience as contact_created when it is linked.

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: A contact with their deals, activities and tasks

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: me, none or a member's id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the deal's, company's or contact's name.

post.summary: Open a deal
post.description: Needs the editor role.

get.summary: A deal with its history, activities, tasks and quotes

post.summary: Move an open deal to another stage
post.description:
Sent to Audience as deal_stage_changed.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Mark a deal won
post.description:
reason, when the pipeline has won_reasons, is one of them. Sent to Audience as deal_won and to Messages.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Mark a deal lost, with the reason
post.description:
reason is one of the pipeline's lost_reasons. Sent to Audience as deal_lost and to Messages.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Reopen a won or lost deal
post.description: Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Make a quote for a deal
post.description:
Without lines, it starts from the deal's last quote, or one line with the deal's name and value. KDV is the file's quotes.vat.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Start a sales sequence in Messages for the deal's contact
post.description:
Posts the sequence's event to Messages' POST /api/v1/events, which starts the journey it triggers.

Needs the editor role.

get.summary: What the deal's contact did, from Audience

post.summary: Log a call, meeting, email or note
post.description: Needs the editor role.

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: me (default), all or a member's id.

post.summary: Add a task
post.description:
Its reminder goes by email the morning it is due, at the file's tasks.remind_at, unless remind is false.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Send a quote, by email as PDF or marked sent
post.description:
A sent quote stays as it was sent. The deal's value becomes the quote's total without KDV.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: The customer accepted: the deal is won at the quote's value
post.description: Needs the editor role.

post.summary: The customer declined
post.description: Needs the editor role.

get.description:
Lines without KDV, then the subtotal, the KDV and the total with KDV, each on its own line.

Needs the viewer role.

post.summary: Import companies, contacts or deals from CSV
post.description:
Comma or semicolon separated, with a header line. Companies match by name or domain, contacts by email; deals are added (or skipped when external_id was imported before). dryRun checks every row and changes nothing.

Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Cancel a booked meeting, in the calendar too
post.description: Needs the editor role.

post.summary: Start connecting Google Calendar or Microsoft 365
post.description:
Answers the provider's consent address; the browser goes there and comes back to /api/v1/calendar/callback.

Needs the viewer role.

get.summary: Where the provider sends the browser back

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: What the connect call began with.

get.description: Free times in the link's hours, from its owner's calendar, less held and confirmed bookings with their buffers. No sign-in; 60 calls a minute from one address.

post.summary: Book a free time
post.description: The calendar is read again; the time is held in one transaction so it is never booked twice, then the event is made with a Meet or Teams link and the contact and deal are found or made. 409 when the time is no longer free. No sign-in; 10 calls a minute from one address.

get.summary: The customer by email, for Helpdesk
get.description:
Exactly the address, lowercased; no names or domains. 404 when no contact has it.

Needs the viewer role.

post.summary: Open a lead, from Live Chat, a form or your systems
post.description:
A deal in the file's leads.stage, its contact found by email or made. The member whose email owner names owns it, else leads.owner, else nobody. The transcript and pages go in the deal's first activity.

Needs the editor role.

200.description: The lead this external_id opened before.

post.summary: Delete a person on request, as Audience asks
post.description:
Every contact with one of the emails or phone numbers goes, with their activities and tasks; deals with no company that were theirs go too, others keep the company's side. Bookings and queued events with the identifiers go. The same reference answers the same again.

Needs the admin role.

apiToken.description: An API token made under Settings, API tokens.

canEdit.description: Whether the caller may change it: admins always, editors when they own it or nobody does.

anyOf.description: A plan id from the file.

probability.description: The share of the value the forecast counts: the stage's while open, 100 won, 0 lost.

anyOf.description: The month the forecast counts it in: when won, or its expected close (this month when that has passed); null for none.

stale.description: Open, and no activity for longer than its stage's stale_after.

vat.description: KDV, 0 to 100, as the file set it when the quote was made.

made.description: created: a new deal in the link's stage; added: to the contact's open deal in that pipeline.

CrmLookup.description: What Helpdesk reads: the contact with exactly this email, their company's plan (whose id Helpdesk routes and sets SLAs by), owner and deals.

LeadRequest.description: Live Chat sends exactly its CrmLeadRequest: external_id, source live-chat, name, email, page, title, owner, referrer, utm, pages, transcript and chat_url. Forms and your own systems may send phone, company, value and message too.

external_id.description: The same id opens one lead, however often it is sent.

anyOf.description: The lead's deal name, up to 120 characters (the first line is kept).
